caveats: Beejern is a currently registered entity; NorthScan's DPRK/front-company relationship is research attribution rather than an adjudicated fact.
Create a Beejern company/network record only after legal/editorial review of the live-company allegation.
Personal addresses, phone numbers, exposed emails, credentials, identity documents, and source-derived face comparisons stay unpublished.
Ryosuke Yamamoto/redsky500 and Naoyuki Tanaka remain separate persona records; company and account continuity require an explicit source link for operator linkage.

statements: NorthScan starts from GoldenDev321's Beejern bio and preserved fork/commit history to assess that GoldenDev321, Redsky500, and Dragonlee321 are successive handles for the same GitHub account/operator shell.
The report links the same account/contact cluster to the already reported Ryosuke Yamamoto employment persona and records a public Torre recommendation from the existing Naoyuki Tanaka persona.

The report correlates Beejern with He-Cat-E/Peakality, SprintiQ.ai, DreamHi.co, and QN Software through repository artifacts, reused company contact infrastructure, shared Vietnam business details, and recurring profile-image fabrication patterns.
NorthScan reports Beejern LLC as an active Oklahoma legal entity and argues that the entity supplies a legitimate-looking corporate layer for client solicitation and payment handling.
